message.timelocked.arrival_welcome.1: [PA · Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang · Pre-recorded] Hello, and welcome to the Sapphire Advanced Research Corporation. I’m Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang.
message.timelocked.arrival_welcome.2: [PA · Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang · Pre-recorded] If you’ve just arrived, take a moment to get your bearings. Reception is your first stop—they’ll help you check in and find where you’re supposed to be.
message.timelocked.arrival_welcome.3: [PA · Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang · Pre-recorded] Please have your identification ready, and keep the main walkway clear. Some of us are still trying to get to work.
message.timelocked.arrival_welcome.4: [PA · Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang · Pre-recorded] A quick reminder: an open security door is not an invitation. If your clearance doesn’t cover what’s on the other side, please leave it alone.
message.timelocked.arrival_welcome.5: [PA · Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang · Pre-recorded] If you feel unwell, or something doesn’t seem right, speak to the medical team. You’re not bothering them. That’s what they’re here for.
message.timelocked.arrival_welcome.6: [PA · Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang · Pre-recorded] And… look after each other, alright? It’s easy to get caught up in the work down here.
message.timelocked.arrival_welcome.7: [PA · Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang · Pre-recorded] Right. That’s enough from me. Welcome to SARC. I’m glad you’re here.

message.timelocked.coast.beat.2: A SARC truck is parked here. I can drive it inland, or take the boardwalk and road on foot.

message.timelocked.coast.beat.5: [You] SARC again. The same name as the coast signs. This road is not leading to a public beach.
message.timelocked.coast.beat.6: [You] A research facility. I do not have identification, or an explanation. But I cannot stay out here.

message.timelocked.staff.start: [Chapter 3: On the Record] <SARC Briefing Officer> Reception sent you? Take a moment. You are not being asked to explain the impossible—just tell me what you actually saw near the college. Speak to me again when you are ready to give your statement.
message.timelocked.staff.witness: <You> A satellite came down beside the Seaton Computing Center. I saw the wreckage. I later ended up on the coast. I cannot explain the connection.
message.timelocked.staff.assignment: <SARC Briefing Officer> I am recording that as a witness account, not a confirmed cause. Your first assignment is read-only orientation: follow the central spine north through the research entrance, then read the workstation just left of the doorway. You have limited research-orientation clearance—not permission to operate containment, bypass security, or enter an airlock. Return here afterward.
message.timelocked.staff.orientation: [Research orientation terminal] Safety briefing acknowledged. Keep containment sealed. Do not touch reactor, portal or fluid controls. Report unusual readings to staff; do not attempt a repair. Return to the briefing officer to confirm your assignment.
message.timelocked.staff.complete: <SARC Briefing Officer> Good. Your statement and orientation are on file. Keep that distinction in mind: what you saw is evidence; what caused it is still a question. Your limited research-orientation clearance remains valid. [Chapter 3: On the Record complete]

message.timelocked.research.line.0: [Briefing Officer] Chapter 4 — The Missing Interval. Your statement is on file, but a statement is not a cause. Build a chronology from independent records. Start at research intake; keep observations separate from guesses.
message.timelocked.research.line.1: [Research intake / case chronology] Your arrival was logged after the coastal approach. The satellite sighting belongs to your earlier account. The system has no verified timestamp joining those events. Select the witness comparison panel next.
message.timelocked.research.line.2: [Witness comparison] You remember the crash, the investigation, and the nighttime intrusion. Reception can verify only your arrival here. Mark the intervening interval UNKNOWN; do not backfill it from either record. Signal review is farther north in the atrium.
message.timelocked.research.objective.2: Chapter 4 — Separate memory from recorded evidence: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.2: Ch. 4 · Separate memory from recorded evidence
message.timelocked.research.line.3: [Signal review / read-only] A discontinuity appears in the copied telemetry, but the copy begins after the original source clock stopped reporting its reference. A blank line is missing data, not a confirmed transmission. Open the clock-quality panel.
message.timelocked.research.line.4: [Signal review / clock quality] Local timestamps and source timestamps cannot be aligned reliably. The offset is not measured. No responsible comparison can place the discontinuity before or after your crash. Check the archive provenance farther north.
message.timelocked.research.line.5: [Archive / provenance] This is an analysis copy, not the satellite recorder. The export preserved the surviving rows and flagged gaps. No recovered fragment or original recorder has been transferred into your custody. Open the handling note.
message.timelocked.research.line.6: [Archive / handling] Preserve the original gap. Do not repair, resample, or overwrite source data. Any later reconstruction must be labeled as a model. Your useful finding is the uncertainty itself. Return to the briefing officer with that distinction.
message.timelocked.research.line.7: [Briefing Officer] Good. Three records, three different limits. We can support your arrival and preserve your account. We cannot name whoever took you or explain how you crossed the gap. Check whether the signal copy contains the same kind of interruption as the intake record.
message.timelocked.research.objective.7: Chapter 4 — Report the limits of the evidence: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.7: Ch. 4 · Report the limits of the evidence
message.timelocked.research.line.8: [Signal comparison] Intake has an interval with no witness record. Telemetry has rows with no reliable clock reference. They are not equivalent measurements. Similar-looking gaps do not establish a common cause. Reception retains the unedited arrival entry.
message.timelocked.research.objective.8: Chapter 4 — Compare the two kinds of missing time: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.8: Ch. 4 · Compare the two kinds of missing time
message.timelocked.research.line.9: [Reception / arrival entry] Visitor registration follows the coastal arrival. The entry contains no prior appointment, transport manifest, or recovered equipment record. This terminal does not manufacture missing identification or clearance. Return to operations to close the review.
message.timelocked.research.objective.9: Chapter 4 — Verify the original arrival entry: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.9: Ch. 4 · Verify the original arrival entry
message.timelocked.research.line.10: [Briefing Officer] A damaged clock, an incomplete export, and an actual event can all leave gaps. We do not have evidence to choose among them yet. Your report will keep those possibilities open rather than turn one into a fact.
message.timelocked.research.line.11: [Briefing Officer] Chapter 4 complete. Your review preserves the records and their limits. Dr. Everleigh has agreed to speak with you here in operations. The meeting is voluntary. Bring your questions, not a conclusion someone expects you to repeat.
message.timelocked.research.objective.11: Chapter 4 — Submit the review and request a meeting: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.11: Ch. 4 · Submit the review and request a meeting
message.timelocked.research.line.12: [Dr. Everleigh Alexi Darkfang] Chapter 5 — Meet the Founder. The voice on the welcome recording is mine. The recording has an easier job than I do: it never has to answer back. You have every reason to ask why you are here. I will distinguish what I know from what I do not.
message.timelocked.research.line.13: [Dr. Everleigh] I have read your account: the satellite, your investigation, the intrusion, then the coast. I will not ask you to repeat it until the details sound more convenient. If a memory changes, we append a correction; we do not erase the first account.
message.timelocked.research.objective.13: Chapter 5 — Tell the founder what you remember: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.13: Ch. 5 · Tell the founder what you remember
message.timelocked.research.line.14: [Dr. Everleigh] I founded SARC to study things that did not fit our existing explanations. That ambition does not exempt us from evidence or duty of care. A visitor is a person, not an instrument we get to keep because the readings are unusual.
message.timelocked.research.objective.14: Chapter 5 — Ask why SARC was founded: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.14: Ch. 5 · Ask why SARC was founded
message.timelocked.research.line.15: [Dr. Everleigh] The Zero Point is a subject of research, not a universal answer. Its existence is not proof that it caused your displacement. Before you accept my version of this place, read the charter and compare its safeguards with the actual records.
message.timelocked.research.objective.15: Chapter 5 — Ask what the Zero Point can explain: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.15: Ch. 5 · Ask what the Zero Point can explain
message.timelocked.research.line.16: [Archive / founding charter] The research mandate requires documented methods, traceable source material, and independent review of anomalous findings. Authority to approve a project is not authority to remove inconvenient evidence. Open the visitor safeguards section.
message.timelocked.research.line.17: [Archive / visitor safeguards] Consent must be specific to the activity. Registration is not consent to experimentation. Orientation clearance is not permission to enter containment. Participants can stop an assignment without surrendering their account. The signal desk holds the case-access history.
message.timelocked.research.line.18: [Case-access history] The analysis copy was opened for this review. There is no source-clock reference attached to it. The log cannot tell you who controlled the original satellite. An absent field is not a deleted confession. Take both the charter and that limit back to Everleigh.
message.timelocked.research.line.19: [Dr. Everleigh] A charter cannot inspect a laboratory. People must be allowed to challenge a result and stop unsafe work, including work I approve. Keep your own account. If our record disagrees with it, that disagreement belongs in the case, not in a waste bin.
message.timelocked.research.objective.19: Chapter 5 — Ask who holds the founder accountable: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.19: Ch. 5 · Ask who holds the founder accountable
message.timelocked.research.line.20: [Dr. Everleigh] I cannot produce a recorder we do not have. I also cannot turn an access log for a copy into a history of the original. We preserve the gap and request the source. You deserve that plain answer more than you need a confident one.
message.timelocked.research.objective.20: Chapter 5 — Challenge the missing source record: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.20: Ch. 5 · Challenge the missing source record
message.timelocked.research.line.21: [Dr. Everleigh] I cannot identify the person you saw from these records. Naming someone now would make our uncertainty harder to correct later. Describe what you actually observed; leave the identity and motive unresolved. We will not trade you a story for your cooperation.
message.timelocked.research.objective.21: Chapter 5 — Ask about the intruder and the boat: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.21: Ch. 5 · Ask about the intruder and the boat
message.timelocked.research.line.22: [Dr. Everleigh] The next assignment is a dry run in public circulation areas: read-only HES familiarization, sample records, and an explicit abort route. No exposure, reactor startup, portal test, or weapons trial. You can leave and resume later. Check in with operations only if you want to continue.
message.timelocked.research.objective.22: Chapter 5 — Agree the limits of a supervised assignment: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.22: Ch. 5 · Agree the limits of a supervised assignment
message.timelocked.research.line.23: [Dr. Everleigh] Chapter 5 complete. You are not obliged to solve this for us. The briefing officer has the training brief; it is deliberately less dramatic than the questions that brought you here. Let us find out whether our procedures work before asking you to trust them.
message.timelocked.research.objective.23: Chapter 5 — Close the meeting with the founder: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.23: Ch. 5 · Close the meeting with the founder
message.timelocked.research.line.24: [Briefing Officer] Chapter 6 — A Controlled Trial. This is a read-only ATLAS HES familiarization exercise, not a live suit issue. Everleigh's personal equipment stays operator-only. You need no armor or consumables. Start at research intake and review the stop conditions.
message.timelocked.research.objective.24: Chapter 6 — Accept the supervised dry run: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.24: Ch. 6 · Accept the supervised dry run
message.timelocked.research.line.25: [Training brief / SIMULATION] Stop for an obstructed route, inconsistent readings, or a person needing help. Do not improvise a shortcut through a restricted door. The route uses the research atrium, connector, reception, and operations only. Open the HES checklist.
message.timelocked.research.objective.25: Chapter 6 — Review the trial and its stop conditions: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.25: Ch. 6 · Review the trial and its stop conditions
message.timelocked.research.line.26: [HES familiarization / SIMULATION] Confirm identity, power status, seals, communications, and a clear exit before a live deployment. A startup announcement is not a safety certificate. This exercise does not equip, charge, or boot an actual suit. Use the signal desk for a sample status report.
message.timelocked.research.objective.26: Chapter 6 — Read the HES preflight checklist: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.26: Ch. 6 · Read the HES preflight checklist
message.timelocked.research.line.27: [HES status / SIMULATION] Sample: power nominal; seal unverified; communications available. Two green fields do not cancel an unknown seal. The safe result is HOLD. Open the response panel to record the training response.
message.timelocked.research.objective.27: Chapter 6 — Inspect the simulated status report: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.27: Ch. 6 · Inspect the simulated status report
message.timelocked.research.line.28: [Training response / SIMULATION] HOLD recorded for the unverified seal. No real power, door, or life-support system was changed. Now walk to the marked atrium checkpoint on the central lane. The checkpoint records position only, not exposure or suit readiness.
message.timelocked.research.objective.28: Chapter 6 — Record a hold rather than a live deployment: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.28: Ch. 6 · Record a hold rather than a live deployment
message.timelocked.research.line.29: [Training route] Atrium checkpoint logged. Keep the clear central lane behind you as an exit. At the archive desk, collect the sample observation without interacting with nearby laboratory machinery.
message.timelocked.research.objective.29: Chapter 6 — Walk to the atrium checkpoint: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.29: Ch. 6 · Walk to the atrium checkpoint
message.timelocked.research.line.30: [Sample observation / SIMULATION] The training sensor gives one nominal value and one missing value. Preserve both. An unknown reading does not become normal because an earlier sample was normal. Walk back south through the manual research doors to the connector checkpoint.
message.timelocked.research.line.31: [Training route] Connector checkpoint logged. This is the exercise's abort route: back through the hub to reception. The shared doors remain manual. Verify the arrival desk can receive a report; do not enter containment or energize equipment.
message.timelocked.research.objective.31: Chapter 6 — Follow the exit route to the connector: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.31: Ch. 6 · Follow the exit route to the connector
message.timelocked.research.line.32: [Reception / training handoff] Sample report received with its missing value intact. Visitor registration and research authorization are unchanged. The physical return route is available. Report to the briefing officer in operations for the discrepancy review.
message.timelocked.research.objective.32: Chapter 6 — Verify the report handoff at reception: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.32: Ch. 6 · Verify the report handoff at reception
message.timelocked.research.line.33: [Briefing Officer] You held the simulated deployment and brought the missing value back instead of filling it in. Now compare the archive copy at the signal desk. If a later record supplies a value without a source, flag the discrepancy rather than silently choosing one.
message.timelocked.research.objective.33: Chapter 6 — Report the held deployment and missing sample: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.33: Ch. 6 · Report the held deployment and missing sample
message.timelocked.research.line.34: [Training comparison / SIMULATION] The later sample copy labels the missing field nominal but cites no measurement. Discrepancy flagged; original retained. This was an authored exercise, not evidence of interference with your real case. Take the escalation to Everleigh.
message.timelocked.research.objective.34: Chapter 6 — Flag the inconsistent training copy: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.34: Ch. 6 · Flag the inconsistent training copy
message.timelocked.research.line.35: [Dr. Everleigh] That is the result I wanted: not a flawless readout, but a person who refuses to pretend one exists. The discrepancy belongs in the report. Training ends without a live deployment. Operations will close your assignment; your original case remains open.
message.timelocked.research.line.36: [Briefing Officer] Report received: preflight hold, atrium observation, connector exit, reception handoff, and unsupported correction. No real hazard was activated. Your personal research record will show training completed, not permission for unsupervised testing.
message.timelocked.research.objective.36: Chapter 6 — Submit the final trial report: %s, %s, %s.
hud.timelocked.objective.research.36: Ch. 6 · Submit the final trial report
message.timelocked.research.line.37: [Briefing Officer] Chapter 6 complete. The evidence review, founder meeting, and controlled trial are on your record. Your displacement remains unresolved. You may explore within your existing access; no new reactor, portal, containment, or equipment privileges have been granted. That is the end of the currently available story.
